definitions: A wheel with a grooved rim over which a rope or chain can run in order to change the direction or point of application of a force applied to the rope or chain, to multiply the force, or to get a mechanical advantage.
A system of one or more such wheels used for lifting heavy objects.
examples: The pulley system made lifting the crate much easier.
He attached the rope to the pulley.
A simple pulley can change the direction of a force.
